ui.title: Grimoire
ui.description: The Mancers grimoire: every house and card, with art, cost, stats and rules text.
ui.footer: Art from the {0} repository. The list itself is {1}.

houses.name: Antimancer
houses.blurb: Turn the opponent's force against him.
houses.author: tiapoka

houses.name: Barbarians
houses.blurb: Specialization: Fury. A Barbarian fights hardest when wounded: below certain life totals their cards wake up, adding attack, striking twice, ignoring the blocker in front, or turning on the spells that hurt them. Let your life fall and the whole deck turns feral.
houses.author: DonnieDarkcore

houses.name: Battlemage
houses.blurb: Specialization: Tactics. Battlemage creatures pair aggressive stats with defensive abilities, or the reverse. Spells serve both attack and protection. Keep the line in balance, then tip it.
houses.author: CyberneticPony

houses.name: Beastlords
houses.blurb: Specialization: Beastlords. The Beastlords bare their soul to the pack: every card they play is revealed, and every beast on the board feels it. The more colors they show, the stronger the pack grows.
houses.author: Fail

houses.name: Blacksmith
houses.blurb: Class special ability - wielder: whenever a Blacksmith spell is cast, the caster must choose one of its creatures of cost 8 or less as the wielder of the spell's effect. The idea behind this class is that it is a defensive class like cleric with a focus on protecting a mana accelerator, but later in the game has good synergy with mid tier cards like Troll and Minotaur instead of high end cards like elementals.
houses.author: bZanno

houses.name: Chaos Priest
houses.blurb: Specialization: Chaos. The Chaos Priest serves no order at all: every card rolls the dice, blocking powers, healing whichever creature they pick, stunning all but one foe and flinging the opponent's summons and spells to random slots.
houses.author: sinist

houses.name: Chronomaster
houses.blurb: Specialization: Time. Freeze the present, skip ahead, and rewind the board to yesterday.
houses.author: panderson

houses.name: Colors
houses.blurb: Each color has a minimal cost. When a special card is summoned, all special mana is spent on it. The amount of mana affects the abilities of colors (X). Only one color of each type can be on the board.
houses.author: Madhatter97

houses.name: Conjurer
houses.blurb: Specialization: Conjuration. Spells and creatures feed each other: every spell you cast triggers Conjure on your creatures. Attack swings, type-mana, and a second pulse from the same play.
houses.author: sfault

houses.name: Dark Priest
houses.blurb: Class special ability — restless soul: at the beginning of the game, a creature with the same name (3/11) appears on the opponent's side. If it dies, it is reborn at the end of the opponent's turn and gives 2 special mana to the Dark Priest.
houses.author: sinist

houses.name: Disciples
houses.blurb: The disciples of the lost church put their faith in the prisoner inside us. He finds his way through drugs, the astral plane, fear, and rage. Prisoner spawns at the end of the owner's turn in a random empty slot of the owner. When a prisoner dies, the owner loses 1 mana from the 2 highest basic houses and earns 1 special mana. When a disciple is low on life (< half), its belief is weakened and it loses 1/3 attack.
houses.author: badsleep

houses.name: Dreamweaver
houses.blurb: The Dreamweaver creates and controls the power of Dreams, a formidable force both in slumber and awake. With enough creative energy, Dreamweavers can turn a fleeting idea into an amazing creature, or create spectacular displays of nature and magic.
houses.author: Wavelength

houses.name: Elementalist
houses.blurb: Heavily relies on four basic elements.
houses.author: sinist

houses.name: Emotion
houses.blurb: Specialization: Emotion. Cowardice, revolt, loneliness, courage, love, hope, teamwork and legend each reward a different state of the board.
houses.author: Floofy

houses.name: Faerie Druid
houses.blurb: Faerie Druids are nature magi that can commune with Faeries, creatures whose very existence is made of special forms of mana. Faeries normally spend their time elaborately acting out rather literal interpretations of humans' lives, dreams, and stories, but they are a force to be reckoned with on the battlefield, where they will lay their lives down for Druids that they deem worthy.
houses.author: Wavelength

houses.name: High Priest
houses.blurb: Class special ability - divine path: depending on whether the total level of the owner's Fire and Earth creatures or of its Water and Air creatures is higher, its special draw changes, becoming Ra's or Set's. "Hermopolis is opened and my head is sealed. O Thoth, the eyes of Horus is unblemished, the Eye of Horus saves me, and splendid are my ornaments from the brow of Ra, father of the gods; I am this Osiris here in the West. Osiris knows his day, and if he does not exist in it, then I will not exist in it. I am Ra who is with the gods and I will not perish; stand up, Horus, that I may number you among the gods."
houses.author: sinist

houses.name: Junk
houses.blurb: Specialization: Scrap. Board control by volume: cheap creatures fill the line, copy each other and die in heaps, until the junk you piled up becomes the wall you win behind.
houses.author: badsleep

houses.name: Kahjivir Huntress
houses.blurb: Specialization: The Hunt. The Kahjivir huntresses pounce on an occupied lane, punish an empty one, and grow fiercer with every kill.
houses.author: valentyne

houses.name: Kinetician
houses.blurb: Slots manipulations, stats manipulations.
houses.author: sinist

houses.name: Lightstave
houses.blurb: Specialization: Auras. A Lightstave conjures a magical sphere around one of your creatures. An Aura is cast like a spell but is not a spell; it remains active until its effect ends or its target dies. Only one Aura of each name can be active at a time.
houses.author: Redrook

houses.name: Limbo
houses.blurb: Keeper of Limbo. Passive ability: whenever an enemy creature attacks and kills Keeper of Limbo or one of its creatures, their death is postponed until the end of Keeper of Limbo's turn, and they are considered to be in 'Limbo-state'. Creatures in 'Limbo-state' attack and block as usual.
houses.author: fuzzer

houses.name: Meteomancers
houses.blurb: Specialization: Prescience. When you summon a Meteo creature, choose a basic element as your Called Element. Most Meteo cards trigger off the opponent playing cards of that element.
houses.author: Wavelength

houses.name: Mountain King
houses.blurb: Hird: while a dwarf stands side by side with another dwarf, it gets its second ability
houses.author: sinist

houses.name: Paganist
houses.blurb: Specialization: Sacrifice. The Paganist spends its own life and creatures to feed an ever-hungrier god. This class revolves around sacrificing your creatures, life, and mana to do massive damage to your opponent and his creatures. Because board control is paramount, and sacrifices put you down a slot, the low end of the deck is designed to have strong synergy with the rest of the class, and the high end of the deck is incredibly powerful compared to the other houses. The other major themes of the class are a similarity to Illusion, where most of the abilities do direct damage, and many of the cards involve interaction with the mana cost of the cards like Illusion 6.
houses.author: Zannoland

houses.name: Powermancer
houses.blurb: Specialization: Power. Bargain with special power to cast anything, sacrifice creatures for power and life, and tax the opponent's power. The Powermancer's cards are all built around one concept: managing your power in a very efficient way.
houses.author: tiapoka

houses.name: Quantumancer
houses.blurb: Specialization: Superposition. Spells that scale with enemy mana, warriors that share their damage, and seals that steal the opponent's options. The various types of magic are all simply different manifestations of raw energy, but recently a few magi, known to most as the Quantumancers, have learned to manipulate the force of Energy itself. These mages can use their finesse to control this primitive force, and attack their foes not only with the powers of the universe but also with the powers that their foes throw at them.
houses.author: Wavelength

houses.name: Rogue
houses.blurb: Specialization: Sneak. Ambush the blocked line, steal growth, and finish what a stab starts. Small bodies, dirty timing.
houses.author: valentyne

houses.name: Seasons
houses.blurb: Passing of Seasons: each of the Warden's special cards grants him a small passive effect that remains active from the beginning of the game until the card is played. Exhaustion: the Warden's special cards may only be used once apiece during the match. A Warden of Seasons is a mage who can control the power of seasons and – through the Magical Law of Sympathy – can also channel phenomena that people associate with seasons. Whereas Chronomasters wield absolute control over time on a very small scope, "Wardens" control seasons by making subtle changes to time on a much more epic scale. On such a grand level, however, the forces of nature and time are fickle, and it is notoriously exhausting – even dangerous – to attempt to manipulate them. Wardens who successfully bring about a change are often reluctant to do so again for a long time.
houses.author: Wavelength

houses.name: Shadowcaster
houses.blurb: Specialization: Dark. Dark power is a separate counter, not mana. Feed on the enemy's fear, cast shadows over the battlefield and call the cursed Dark Elves from the Shadow Realms. The Shadowcaster uses her powers of Darkness to confuse her enemies & sew chaos into the ranks of her foes, feeding off of their fear to bolster her own Dark Energy. From deep out of the Sacred Darkness, the Shadowcaster summons the cursed Dark Elves from the Shadow Realms to do her bidding, & cast a grotesque shadow over the battlefield.
houses.author: Redrook

houses.name: Shadowmage
houses.blurb: Specialization: Stealth. The Shadowmage weaves immense protection that fades - shields, silence, and unseen blades that last only a turn. Most of the idea behind this class is to apply an immense level of protection, but temporarily. Like an effect that "fades". This way, the idea of stealth as a mechanic can now be imagined in the spectromancer universe.
houses.author: lordvanmaru

houses.name: Shaman
houses.blurb: Spirit of ancestors: at the beginning of the game, a ghost wolf 2/18 (cost 2, no special ability) appears in the rightmost slot. If the wolf dies, it is replaced by a new wolf summon.
houses.author: sinist

houses.name: Snowblood
houses.blurb: Specialization: Control. Cold, materialistic and a bit cynical board control: every kill has a price, every favour a debt. Warmth is not part of the Snowblood contract. The only hope is to wait for Amaterasu who can recognize her creatures.
houses.author: badsleep

houses.name: Soul Reaper
houses.blurb: When a creature on the field dies, the owner gets 1 soul. For every soul the owner has, all damage dealt by its special spells is increased by 1 (1 soul = 1 damage)
houses.author: sinist

houses.name: Soulbinder
houses.blurb: The Soulbinder always starts the duel with 1 Bound Soul in play in a random slot. Bound Soul does not attack. Bound Soul receives no damage from attacking creatures, abilities, or spells. A creature opposite a Bound Soul does not attack the Bound Soul but rather attacks the owner directly as if the slot were empty. Any creature may be summoned onto a Bound Soul; when this occurs, the Bound Soul is no longer in play. A Bound Soul neither "dies" nor is "destroyed". The Soulbinder is deeply connected to the Spirits of the world, living on the edge of the World of the Living & the Spirit World beyond. She must respect & care for the lost souls & escort them to their final rest. A Soulbinder can also call on & control the Spirits to aid her in battle. Protector of Life & Speaker of the Passed.
houses.author: Redrook

houses.name: Sower
houses.blurb: HP manipulations.
houses.author: sinist

houses.name: Spirit Shaman
houses.blurb: Specialization: Release. Spirit power is the special mana. Summon Spirit Totems; when a totem's Release condition is met it is replaced in its slot by its Spirit creature. The Spirit Shaman taps into the Spirit Realm for insight & strength, allowing the spirits of the wilderness to guide her. She uses the power of ancient Spirit Totems to call upon the creatures of the Spirit Realm & Release them into the realm of the living to fight alongside her.
houses.author: Redrook

houses.name: Tinker
houses.blurb: Specialization: Tinker. A steampunk workshop that seeds the enemy line with ticking bombs, then spends them - extra swings, growing soldiers, and a queen who turns every fuse into a blast.
houses.author: Redrook

houses.name: Trappers
houses.blurb: Specialization: Control. The Trappers have an incredible link with the dark force of earth's power: with their spectromancer powers and the help of the doom roots and dark forest creatures they trap the enemy's creatures and take control of every battle.
houses.author: zhupons

houses.name: Warp
houses.blurb: Specialization: Disruption. Warp does not hold a line, it breaks one: abilities are stripped, creatures are unmade and replaced, and what the opponent built is turned against them.
houses.author: badsleep

houses.name: Wind
houses.blurb: Master of Wind
houses.author: sinist

houses.name: Zen
houses.blurb: Specialization: Balance. Zen answers the board as it stands: the strongest threat is met, the weakest ally is mended, and every empty slot may still turn into gain.
houses.author: badsleep

cards.text: When summoned, it heals all other allied creatures for 9 life. All other allied creatures receive +1 attack and take -1 damage while Cornucopia is on the board. Passive: Plentitude: the cost of your most expensive Fire, Water, Air and Earth cards is reduced by 1.

cards.name: Gaea's Avatar
cards.text: Its attack is equal to the number of creatures on the board. Gaea's Avatar is unaffected by all spells but takes 1 damage each turn for each empty slot on the board. Passive: Plentitude: the cost of your most expensive Fire, Water, Air and Earth cards is reduced by 1.

cards.name: Behemoth of Frozen Time
cards.text: When summoned, the opponent's blocked creatures are stunned for a turn. The opponent's mana in each House cannot grow higher than 9 while Behemoth of Frozen Time is in play. Passive: Wintry Chill: the opponent's unblocked creatures take 1 damage each turn.

cards.name: The Great Aurora
cards.text: The caster's creatures are healed for 16 life, and each grants 3 mana of their own type to the caster. Passive: Wintry Chill: the opponent's unblocked creatures take 1 damage each turn.

cards.name: Nectarbloom
cards.text: Nectarbloom regenerates 2 life each turn.

cards.name: Giant Bat
cards.text: Each time Giant Bat deals damage to an opposing creature, it heals itself 3 life.

cards.name: Shadow Wave
cards.text: Deals X+2 damage to all opponent's creatures (X = caster's Dark power).

cards.name: Dark Elf Noble
cards.text: If killed by an opponent's spell, increases its owner's Dark power by 2.

cards.name: Dark Elf Mage
cards.text: Increases the cost of all its owner's spells by 1 and their damage by 2. Each time its owner casts a spell, increases its owner's Dark power by 1.

cards.name: Shadow Scythe
cards.text: Deals X+4 damage to all opponent's creatures (X = caster's Dark power). For each creature killed, deals 2 damage to the opponent and increases the caster's Dark power by 1.

cards.name: Dark Elf Assassin
cards.text: Attacks in the same turn it is summoned. Each time it kills an opponent's creature, increases its owner's Dark power by 1.

cards.name: Moonblade
cards.text: At the beginning of its owner's turn, deals damage to all opponent's creatures equal to its owner's Dark power. Each time it kills a creature, increases its owner's Dark power by 1.

cards.name: Priestess of Shadows
cards.text: When summoned, stuns all opponent's creatures. When killed, increases its owner's Dark power by 2.

cards.name: Shadow Archer
cards.text: When summoned, deals 6 damage to the opponent. When Shadow Archer dies, the opponent heals 6 life.

cards.name: Shade Stalker
cards.text: Shade Stalker's position is not revealed to the opponent until it receives damage.

cards.name: Nightshroud Weaver
cards.text: When summoned, neighboring creatures ignore all damage until the end of the opponent's next turn.

cards.name: Silencer
cards.text: When summoned, the opposing creature cannot attack, and the opponent cannot use cards of that creature's element, until the end of their next turn.

cards.name: Eclipse
cards.text: Increases the caster's Fire, Water, Air, and Earth powers by 2. The caster ignores up to 30 damage until the end of the opponent's next turn.

cards.name: Spike of Pain
cards.text: Deals 16 damage to all enemy creatures. At the end of the caster's turn, heals all enemy creatures by 16 life.

cards.name: Dark Warden
cards.text: Dark Warden always ignores the first damage it receives every turn.

cards.name: Grandmaster Assassin
cards.text: When summoned, deals 12 damage to the creature in the opposing slot. Can replace any allied creature of cost 9 or lower. The caster gains power of the replaced creature's element equal to half that creature's cost (rounded up).

cards.name: Unappeasable Hunger
cards.text: The wolf receives +X attack (X = attack of the target creature) for 1 turn.

cards.name: Spirit of rage
cards.text: When it enters the game, it permanently increases the attack of neighbors by 1.

cards.name: Power of full moon
cards.text: Permanently decreases the damage dealt to the wolf by 1 and heals 8 life to its neighbors and its owner.

cards.name: Phantom fury
cards.text: Deals 8 damage to all enemy creatures and permanently increases the wolf's attack by 1 for each creature that died this turn.

cards.name: Spirit protector
cards.text: While the protector remains in the game, all damage received by the owner is decreased by 2, and enemy spells heal the wolf instead of damaging it.

cards.name: Spirit hunter
cards.text: While the hunter remains in the game, the wolf gets +2 attack and heals itself by the damage dealt when it attacks.

cards.name: Wolf shadow
cards.text: All cards which affect the wolf also affect the wolf shadow. When it enters the game, its neighbors attack immediately.

cards.name: Phantom mate
cards.text: When it enters the game, it permanently decreases the cost of wolf cards by 1 and deals 8 damage to the opponent. Every turn, the wolf additionally attacks the slot opposite the mate.

cards.name: ghost wolf
cards.text: The Shaman's companion. It has no ability of its own: the Shaman's other cards change its attack, its life and the damage it takes.

cards.name: Tracker
cards.text: When a creature is summoned in an adjacent slot, it gains invulnerability for 1 turn

cards.name: Bounty hunter
cards.text: When summoned, it deals 2 damage to the opposite creature. When it kills the opposite creature, it gives the owner 1/3 of its cost in mana (rounded up)

cards.name: Maiko
cards.text: While alive, it decreases by 1 the attack of the opposite creature and its neighbors. Each turn, it heals 1 hp to adjacent friendly creatures. After its summon, its card is replaced with a death letter (cost 3, 0/3 - reduces damage dealt to it to 1 and cannot be healed). When it dies, it deals 15 damage to the opposite creature

cards.name: Echo
cards.text: Instantly triggers for all friendly creatures "each turn" and "direct" effects, then all friendly Snowblood creatures attack

cards.name: Kojiro
cards.text: Can be summoned on any slot of the owner, occupied or empty. It attacks when summoned, with +4 attack on that turn if there is a creature in the opposite slot. Every turn, it deals 2 damage to the opposite creature and all its neighbors (neighbors are the successive filled slots around it)

cards.name: War guide
cards.text: The next summoned creature deals to all enemy creatures damage equal to its attack. When a friendly special creature is summoned, it heals 1 hp to all its neighbors (neighbors are the successive filled slots around it)

cards.name: Janus
cards.text: When summoned and each turn, it heals 2 life to itself and its adjacent slots, and deals 1 damage to the owner's other creatures; for each creature it wounds, its owner gains 1 life and 1 mana of that creature's house

cards.name: Amaterasu
cards.text: When the owner summons a creature of element: - Anger: Amaterasu deals 5 damage to the opposite creature - Sadness: increases the lowest power by 1 - Fear: deals 3 damage to the opponent - Joy: heals 3 hp to the owner

cards.name: Death letter
cards.text: Reduces damage to 1. When it dies, it deals 15 damage to the opposite creature. (Cannot be healed)

cards.name: Damnation
cards.text: Target a creature and deal 3 damage to it. If the creature dies because of this spell, increase the number of souls by x, where x is equal to the creature's cost (max. damage 8)

cards.name: Dark Passage
cards.text: Select 1 target creature. This creature and its neighboring creatures are healed for x life, where x is equal to the number of souls you have (max. heal 12 life)

cards.name: Eternal Rage
cards.text: Select 1 target creature; it cannot be destroyed for the next 2 turns, however much damage it takes.

cards.name: Onslaught of souls
cards.text: Deal x damage to all the opponent's creatures, where x is equal to the number of souls you have. After this spell is used, the owner does not receive souls for creatures killed by this spell, and the number of souls the owner has becomes 0

cards.name: Tribute
cards.text: Select 1 target creature of the owner and destroy it; the owner gets x life, where x is equal to the life of the destroyed creature (max. life 36)

cards.name: Furious souls
cards.text: Deal x + 7 damage to the opponent, where x is equal to the owner's number of souls. After this spell is used, the number of souls is reduced to 0

cards.name: Death Sentence
cards.text: Destroys all creatures on the field. For every destroyed creature, the owner receives 2 souls instead of 1

cards.name: Soul Shackles
cards.text: The target creature cannot attack and its ability is cancelled. Its slot cannot be used until the end of the duel. For every turn the trapped creature remains on the field, the owner gets 1 soul. If the owner summons something in front of that slot after the opponent's creature is destroyed, that creature receives 6 damage every turn

cards.name: Tethered Soul
cards.text: Must be summoned onto a Bound Soul. When Tethered Soul dies, it is replaced by a Bound Soul.

cards.name: Spiritual Summoning
cards.text: Summons a Bound Soul into the target empty slot and increases the caster's Fire, Water, Air and Earth powers by 1.

cards.name: Soulseed Tree
cards.text: Must be summoned onto a Bound Soul. At the beginning of its owner's turn, Soulseed Tree puts a Bound Soul into one of its neighboring slots (left to right) if that slot is not already occupied.

cards.name: Soul Seeker
cards.text: Must be summoned onto a Bound Soul. At the end of its owner's turn, Soul Seeker moves into a random empty slot and puts a Bound Soul in the slot it used to occupy.

cards.name: Spiritual Release
cards.text: Heals the caster and all of the caster's creatures for 3 life for each Bound Soul in play (own and opponent), then removes all Bound Souls from play (own and opponent) and puts 2 Bound Souls into random empty slots of the owner.

cards.name: Soul Sheppard
cards.text: Must be summoned onto a Bound Soul. Soul Sheppard's attack is increased by 1 for each Bound Soul the owner controls. Each turn, Soul Sheppard heals the owner for 2 life for each Bound Soul the owner controls.

cards.name: Priestess of Passage
cards.text: Must be summoned onto a Bound Soul. When summoned, Priestess of Passage heals 2 life to the owner and deals 2 damage to the opponent for each Bound Soul in play (own and opponent). Each time one of the owner's creatures dies, Priestess of Passage puts a Bound Soul into a random empty slot of the owner.

cards.name: Spirit Dragon
cards.text: Must be summoned onto a Bound Soul. When summoned, Spirit Dragon deals 6 damage to the opponent and to all of the opponent's creatures. Each turn, Spirit Dragon heals itself and its owner for 3 life for each Bound Spirit the owner controls.

cards.name: Tangling
cards.text: Transfers X health from the target creature to the opposite creature (X = attack of the target creature).

cards.name: Devouring
cards.text: Sacrifices a friendly creature and doubles the attack of the rest of the friendly creatures for 1 turn.

cards.name: Monster plant
cards.text: When it kills a creature, it fully heals all monster plants on the board.

cards.name: Pollination
cards.text: Turns the target creature of level X into a special creature of level (X minus 3) with full hp and heals X life to the owner.

cards.name: Blood sundew
cards.text: When it deals damage, it regenerates the same amount of hp.

cards.name: Predator plant
cards.text: When it attacks a creature, it deals X additional damage to it (X = difference between its current and max hp).

cards.name: Forest drake
cards.text: When the owner summons a special creature, it creates a copy of it in the nearest empty slot.

cards.name: Fiery flower
cards.text: Every turn it halves the health of the enemy creature with the highest hp and gives 1 Anger power to the owner. When it enters the game, it deals X damage to the opponent (X = its Anger power)

cards.name: Tortoise Totem
cards.text: When summoned, it releases every Totem in neighboring slots. Release: when its owner summons another Spirit creature.

cards.name: Fox Totem
cards.text: When summoned, deals damage to the opposite creature equal to that creature's attack. Release: at the beginning of its owner's turn, if its life is 5 or less.

cards.name: Deer Totem
cards.text: Each turn heals its owner 1 life. Release: at the beginning of its owner's turn, if the owner's Earth power is 7 or more.

cards.name: Owl Totem
cards.text: When summoned, increases its owner's lowest Fire, Water, Air or Earth power by 1. Release: when one of those powers is 1 or less.

cards.name: Panther Totem
cards.text: Its attack increases by 1 each turn, but it may not attack. Release: when the combined attack of Panther Totem and its neighbors is 12 or more.

cards.name: Spiritual Awakening
cards.text: Heals the caster and all the caster's creatures by an amount equal to the owner's Spirit power (before the spell's cost is paid) and releases all the caster's Totems.

cards.name: Bear Totem
cards.text: In the turn it is summoned, increases the attack of all other creatures of its owner by 2. Release: when there are at least 8 creatures on the board (including itself).

cards.name: Eagle Totem
cards.text: When summoned, increases its owner's Spirit power by 4. Release: when its owner's Spirit power is 8 or more.

cards.name: Tortoise Spirit
cards.text: When released, increases its owner's Spirit power by 1.

cards.name: Fox Spirit
cards.text: When released, all other Totems of its owner are released too, even if their Release condition is not met.

cards.name: Deer Spirit
cards.text: When released, heals all other creatures of its owner 6 life.

cards.name: Owl Spirit
cards.text: When released, increases its owner's lowest Fire, Water, Air or Earth power by 2.

cards.name: Panther Spirit
cards.text: Its attack is 2 plus the attack Panther Totem had when released. When it kills an opponent's creature it attacks again immediately.

cards.name: Bear Spirit
cards.text: When released, deals 8 damage to all opponent's creatures.

cards.name: Eagle Spirit
cards.text: When released, reduces its owner's Spirit power by 4 and increases all the owner's other powers by 2.

cards.name: Tinker
cards.text: Place a Tinkerbomb in target open opponent slot.

cards.name: Clockwork Spider
cards.text: When summoned, places a Tinkerbomb in the opposite slot if it is empty. When Clockwork Spider kills an opposing creature, it attacks again.

cards.name: Clockwork Falcon
cards.text: When summoned, places a Tinkerbomb in the rightmost open opponent slot. When it dies, places a Tinkerbomb in the leftmost open opponent slot.

cards.name: Scatterbomb
cards.text: Deals 8 damage to all opponent creatures. For each creature that dies from this spell, place a Tinkerbomb in the slot that creature occupied.

cards.name: Steam Soldier
cards.text: Each time an opponent Tinkerbomb dies, Steam Soldier's attack is increased by 1 permanently.

cards.name: Automaton
cards.text: At the end of its owner's turn, Automaton places a Tinkerbomb in a random open opponent slot.

cards.name: Clockwork Queen
cards.text: When summoned, kills all opponent Tinkerbombs in play. While Clockwork Queen is in play, all Tinkerbombs deal an additional 3 damage to the opponent.

cards.name: Steam Dragon
cards.text: Attacks when summoned. When summoned, places a Tinkerbomb in three random open opponent slots. Each time Steam Dragon kills an opposing creature, its owner gains 1 Tinker power.

cards.name: Tinkerbomb
cards.text: Loses 1 life each turn. When Tinkerbomb dies, it deals 3 damage to its owner.

cards.name: Psychic Shaman
cards.text: When the Shaman is summoned, the creature in the opposing slot skips its next attack. The Shaman attacks the turn it is summoned.

cards.name: Whip Master
cards.text: While it is in play, each creature the opponent summons on a later turn makes the opponent lose 5 life.

cards.name: Underworld Rose
cards.text: The target opponent creature skips its next attack and takes damage equal to half its life, rounded up.

cards.name: Dark Pixie
cards.text: While it is in play, the creature in the opposing slot cannot attack.

cards.name: Underground Poison
cards.text: Destroys the target opponent creature. The opponent gains mana equal to the destroyed creature's cost minus 3.

cards.name: Poisonous Roots
cards.text: The opponent's creatures cannot attack next turn and all the opponent's powers are reduced by 1.

cards.name: Mind Witch
cards.text: The creature in the opposing slot loses its ability: any creature there is silenced while the Witch is in play.

cards.name: Psychic Medusa
cards.text: Each turn, the opponent creature with the highest life skips its attack.

cards.name: Dark flock
cards.text: Moves the owner's creature with the lowest hp into the target slot and makes it invulnerable for 1 turn if its level is not higher than 9.

cards.name: Noctule
cards.text: When it deals damage to the opponent, it heals its owner the same amount of life.

cards.name: Ghoul
cards.text: If the opposite creature has less than 11 life, it kills it at one blow.

cards.name: Acolyte
cards.text: When an enemy creature receives more than 5 damage, it additionally deals 4 damage to it.

cards.name: Blood ties
cards.text: Destroys the owner's creature and permanently increases the attack of its neighbors by its attack (it does not affect creatures with mass attack nor creatures of level higher than 9).

cards.name: Nosferatu
cards.text: When a creature dies, it heals its owner by 3 and itself by 2.

cards.name: Aristocrat
cards.text: At the beginning of the turn, it moves into the slot opposite the opponent's creature with the lowest hp (it can switch places with a friendly creature). When it kills a creature, it deals the opponent damage equal to its attack.

cards.name: Mansion
cards.text: When one of the owner's non-special creatures dies, it replaces it with a neophyte. On entering the game, it turns its neighbors into ghouls.

cards.name: Neophyte
cards.text: It heals itself for half of the damage dealt to enemies.

cards.name: Errant
cards.text: Hides in the shadows after killing a creature and comes back when damaged

cards.name: Earthquake
cards.text: Deals to each enemy creature damage equal to the difference between the owner's and the opponent's powers of its element

cards.name: Cloak
cards.text: Should be summoned on an existing creature; it adds that creature's attack and life to its own. When summoned, it gives 2 mana of the cloaked creature's element. When it dies, it restores that creature

cards.name: Photographer
cards.text: When an adjacent creature dies, it is replaced by a Photographer with the same hp

cards.name: Schizo
cards.text: When summoned, the opposite creature loses its abilities until Schizo's death

cards.name: Ram
cards.text: When summoned, it halves the life of the opposite creature, rounded up. The creature's owner gains 1 mana of that creature's house and loses 1 mana of every other house. Without an opposite creature, nothing happens

cards.name: Stranger
cards.text: Its attack is equal to the highest enemy power. When summoned, it copies the effect of the opposite creature (except multiattack and immediate effects)

cards.name: Warp Queen
cards.text: When summoned, it deals 4 damage to enemy creatures. They lose their abilities until the end of the next turn

cards.name: Winged Warrior
cards.text: The next creature summoned attacks on the same turn it is summoned.

cards.name: Simoom
cards.text: Stuns the target elemental creature and gives X mana of that creature's element (X = half the creature's cost, rounded down)

cards.name: Ball Lightning
cards.text: Deals 7 damage to the opponent and allows an additional card this turn.

cards.name: Squall
cards.text: Allows two additional cards this turn and deals 1 damage to all enemies

cards.name: Energetic vortex
cards.text: Increases damage dealt by the owner's next spell by 50% and transfers 2 Fear mana from the opponent to the owner.

cards.name: The spirit of thunderstorm
cards.text: Gives 1 special mana per turn. Deals 3 damage to all enemies when the owner skips a turn.

cards.name: Whirlwind
cards.text: Destroys the target creature and the opposite one, and allows an additional card this turn.

cards.name: Eternal Storm
cards.text: This turn, all friendly creatures attack the opponent directly.

cards.name: Elementalist
cards.text: Deals damage to the opposite card, and to all opposite cards of the same mana.

cards.name: Redlight
cards.text: Increases by 1 the attack of itself and of the adjacent creatures, as long as the creature in the opposite slot has a higher attack.

cards.name: Focus
cards.text: Gain 1 mana of the house for the opponent's two strongest creatures and for your two weakest.

cards.name: Electric guard
cards.text: Deals 3 damage to creatures that damage the owner.

cards.name: Dreamer
cards.text: Each turn deals 4 damage to the weakest opponent creature (leftmost if tied) and loses 2 life.

cards.name: Mimic
cards.text: At the start of your turn, a cocoon appears on a random empty slot. Summon a creature there to gain 2 mana of its house and 3 life.

cards.name: Zen Fighter
cards.text: If the opposite creature has stronger attack or more life or higher cost, each turn gains 1 mana of that creature's house and heals 3 life. Absorbs 7 damage from spells and abilities. Each time the owner is hit, his attack increases by 1 for one turn.

cards.name: Inertia
cards.text: Immune to spells. Spawns Matter in the next empty slot to the right. When summoned and each turn, while Matter is in play, heals the owner's weakest creature by 3.

cards.name: Matter
cards.text: When summoned and each turn, while Inertia is in play, deals 3 damage to the opponent's strongest creature.
